summary: Phase N introduces a multi-channel notification orchestration layer with SendGrid email, Twilio SMS, and in-app delivery. Backend services resolve per-category preferences, persist delivery tracking, and dispatch asynchronously to prevent blocking upstream callers. Frontend provides notification bell, dropdown, history page, and preference toggles. BOTH REVIEWERS confirm blocking security, schema, compilation, and integration issues that must be resolved before merge.
verdict_reasoning: Verdict is CHANGES_REQUESTED because: (1) CRITICAL: Controllers are unauthenticated — endpoints hardcode user identity and lack JwtGuard, allowing public access to all notification read/write/delete and preference operations. (2) CRITICAL: Code does not compile — TypeScript errors in imports, enums, DTOs, and missing dependencies (date-fns); schema drift between migration SQL and Prisma client. (3) CRITICAL: Integration incomplete — domain events are declared but never emitted or listened; no trigger path exists from auctions/subscriptions to notifications. (4) CRITICAL: Delivery not durable — persistence is deferred with setImmediate, writes are non-atomic, no retry queue or worker; failed sends are permanent. (5) BLOCKING PLAN ITEMS UNCHECKED: Items 1-4 (database migration schema coherence), 7-15 (services, controllers, verification), 16-24 (integration, testing, configuration).

blocking_findings.title: Controllers are unauthenticated — endpoints publicly accessible
blocking_findings.description: Both NotificationsController and NotificationPreferencesController hardcode userId as placeholder string 'user-id-from-jwt' without applying @UseGuards(JwtGuard) or @CurrentUser() decorator. All endpoints (GET notifications, POST mark-read, DELETE, GET/POST preferences) are publicly accessible. Any caller can read, modify, or delete any user's notifications and preferences.
blocking_findings.action_required: Apply @UseGuards(JwtGuard), inject @CurrentUser() decorator, extract userId from JWT sub claim. Verify user owns notification before read/delete. This is blocking for release.

blocking_findings.title: Phase N does not compile — TypeScript errors and missing dependencies
blocking_findings.description: Targeted API typecheck fails: PrismaService import from @uth/database is incorrect (exports Client, not injectable service), ZodValidationPipe does not exist in @nestjs/common, ioredis is undeclared, Twilio namespace is not callable, DeliveryStatus enum mismatches string status values, DTO fields violate strict initialization. Frontend typecheck fails: date-fns is not in apps/web/package.json but imported in NotificationItem.tsx. Build cannot proceed.
blocking_findings.action_required: Fix all import paths, add missing dependencies (date-fns to web, declare ioredis in api), resolve enum/type conflicts, fix DTO initialization. Run npm run typecheck for apps/api and apps/web; ensure both pass before merge.

blocking_findings.title: Migration and Prisma schema drift — generated client misses new fields
blocking_findings.description: Migration 20261128_notifications_sms_phone_timestamps adds SMS enum value, UserProfile.phoneNumber, NotificationDelivery.createdAt/updatedAt/retry index to PostgreSQL. Modular Prisma schema sources still define only IN_APP and EMAIL enum values, omit phoneNumber, and omit delivery timestamps. Regenerating schema.prisma removes the new fields from client model even though migration adds them to database, creating schema-database mismatch.
blocking_findings.action_required: Update all modular Prisma schema source files to include SMS enum, phoneNumber field, and delivery timestamps. Regenerate schema.prisma and validate migration + generated client together. Verify: npm run db:validate && npm run build:schema && npm run typecheck.

blocking_findings.title: Domain event triggers are absent — notifications never dispatched from auctions/subscriptions
blocking_findings.description: Design specifies domain events (bid.accepted, break.started, break.ended, auction.ended, subscription.expiring) should trigger NotificationService.dispatchNotification. Confirmed: event file declares interfaces only, NotificationService has no @OnEvent handlers, no @OnEvent listeners are registered in module, and AuctionsModule/SubscriptionsModule do not emit events. No production path invokes notification dispatch. Event integration is deferred to Phase N.2 but marked as Phase N in plan, leaving feature non-functional.
blocking_findings.action_required: Either (A) add @OnEvent handlers to NotificationService in this phase and coordinate AuctionsModule/SubscriptionsModule to emit events, OR (B) clarify Phase N.2 scope and document event integration as deferred. For now, review plan item 16 (Verify Event Emission in AuctionsModule) and item 17 (Implement Event Listeners) are UNCHECKED and blocking.

blocking_findings.title: Delivery is neither durable nor retried — failed sends are permanent
blocking_findings.description: Persistence is deferred with setImmediate, allowing process exit before data is written. Notification and NotificationDelivery writes are separate, allowing partial state if one fails. No background worker consumes pending deliveries or retries failed sends. getPendingDeliveries and incrementAttempts methods exist but are unused. Failed email/SMS (non-rate-limited) is marked FAILED permanently; rate-limited SMS stays PENDING forever. NOTIFICATION_RETENTION_DAYS config is never consumed. Without a retry queue, transient provider failures become permanent data loss.
blocking_findings.action_required: Implement durable outbox pattern: commit Notification + NotificationDelivery records transactionally with the domain operation. Add background retry job (cron or queue worker) that runs every 5 minutes, claims pending deliveries, re-attempts with exponential backoff, and marks retries as FAILED after N attempts. Alternatively, defer retry implementation to Phase N.3 and document as incomplete.

deduped_findings.title: Client route and authentication contracts do not match API
deduped_findings.description: Frontend hooks call /api/v1/notifications with cookies and credentials: 'include', but Next.js app does not proxy or rewrite this path. API uses bearer tokens via shared Axios interceptor. Nest enables versioning with default version 1; controllers embed v1 in paths without VERSION_NEUTRAL, creating doubled version prefix. Routes do not align.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Declare one route version strategy (remove v1 from controller paths or disable Nest versioning). Ensure frontend uses shared authenticated client with bearer tokens, not cookies.

deduped_findings.title: SMS rate limit is global per-user, not per-auction/category
deduped_findings.description: Once a user hits 1 SMS per 5 minutes (global limit), next notification marked PENDING regardless of category or auction. User bidding on two auctions in rapid succession gets SMS only for first bid; second is deferred silently. Rate limit key includes only userId, not auctionId or category.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Clarify product intent: is global per-user rate limit by design (spam prevention) or should it be per-category/auction? If by design, document trade-off. If not, refactor rate-limit key to include auctionId or category.

deduped_findings.title: Unread notification count calculation is unoptimized — O(n) filter on every render
deduped_findings.description: useNotifications hook derives unread count by filtering notifications array on every render: `notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length`. With 100+ notifications in state, unnecessary re-renders cause performance degradation.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Memoize unread count with useMemo, or compute unreadCount in backend response. Return authoritative unread count with notifications list.

deduped_findings.title: Frontend optimistic updates do not revert on error — stale state risk
deduped_findings.description: markAsRead and deleteNotification update local state immediately, but if backend call fails, UI state remains mutated. Marked-as-read notification stays read in UI but backend shows unread. Users refresh and see notifications re-appear, causing confusion.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add error boundary: revert state if backend response indicates failure. Consider pessimistic updates (wait for server confirmation before updating local state) for critical operations.

deduped_findings.title: Idempotency only applies to auction events, not all categories
deduped_findings.description: checkIdempotency requires auctionId and playerId but queries only userId, category, time window, and data.auctionId (playerId is never compared in query). SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRING and other non-auction events are never deduplicated. Duplicate subscription-expiry notifications will be sent if same event triggers twice within 60 seconds.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Persist stable event key under unique constraint and create atomically. Add fallback idempotency for non-auction events using category + data.subscriptionId or other stable identifier.

deduped_findings.title: History and unread badge only represent the first slice — older notifications invisible
deduped_findings.description: useNotifications hardcodes page=1, discards pagination metadata, exposes no page or category parameter. History page filters only 20 local records; badge counts only 5 recent notifications. Older unread notifications are invisible in badge (count always ≤5). Pagination and filtering are non-functional.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Return authoritative unread count from backend. Add server-driven pagination and category filter. Expose page, limit, and category parameters in hooks and pages.

deduped_findings.title: Account screens bypass app shell and lack mobile/keyboard behavior
deduped_findings.description: Account screens live under src/pages/account, while shell and AuthProvider live in src/app/layout.tsx. Routes do not inherit App Router header, footer, provider, or stylesheet setup. Layout pages use fixed multi-column tables that break at 375px. Notification row clickables are divs without keyboard semantics. Toggles lack accessible names and aria-checked. Dropdown lacks focus management and menu semantics. Does not meet stated 375px and keyboard requirements.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Move account screens to src/app/account/.../page.tsx under App Router to inherit layout. Add responsive card layout for 375px mobile. Add semantic controls (button, aria-checked, role=menuitem) and focus management. Test with keyboard navigation and screen readers.

deduped_findings.title: Provider configuration does not fail closed — missing credentials degrade silently
deduped_findings.description:
If SENDGRID_API_KEY is unset, adapter logs warning and marks delivery FAILED; email is unavailable without system alert. Twilio sender number is optional and falls back to dummy +1234567890; valid credentials with no sender trigger real SMS from invalid origin. SendGrid HTML interpolates emailBody directly into

${emailBody}

; external data can inject markup.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Require complete provider configuration and fail on startup if credentials are missing. Escape dynamic content in email templates or use encoding template system. Add observability: alert on provider failures.

deduped_findings.title: Preference updates clobber omitted channels and do not enforce consent
deduped_findings.description: updatePreferencesForCategory receives optional channel fields; omitted values reset to defaults (inApp: true, email: false, sms: false). One-channel update resets other channels. Upserts are non-transactional; partial state exposed on failure. Enabling a channel manufactures consentedAt without validated user action.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Preserve omitted values in upserts. Apply preference changes transactionally. Record consentedAt only from validated user action (e.g., checkbox on signup). Add backend consent validation for marketing categories.

deduped_findings.title: Race condition: preference changes during dispatch
deduped_findings.description: If user disables email while BID_WON event is being processed, dispatch may still send email because resolveEnabledChannels is called once at start and not re-checked during adapter execution. Edge case; preference changes take 0–5 seconds to take effect. Acceptable for notification system but worth documenting.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Document this behavior in service comments. Consider re-checking preferences before each adapter dispatch if stricter consistency is required.

deduped_findings.title: Migration lacks rollback for enum ADD VALUE
deduped_findings.description: PostgreSQL enum ADD VALUE is irreversible. If migration is rolled back in production, SMS enum value remains and causes inconsistencies. This is PostgreSQL limitation, not code defect, but requires acknowledgment.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Document this operational limitation. Plan for enum removal in future migration if SMS support is deprecated. Consider enum versioning strategy.

deduped_findings.title: Test suite is placeholder only — no actual tests for notification system
deduped_findings.description: apps/api/src/notifications/__tests__ contains only placeholder.spec.ts with expect(true).toBe(true). No unit or integration tests for services, adapters, preferences, rate limiting, or delivery. No frontend notification tests. Plan claims 85+ tests and >85% coverage; none exist.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Add unit tests for NotificationService (dispatch, idempotency, channel resolution), adapters (email/SMS construction, provider calls, error handling), preferences (CRUD, defaults, validation), rate limit (increment, threshold), and delivery (record creation, status updates). Add E2E tests for notification flow. Measure coverage; defer if necessary to follow-up phase but document as incomplete.

deduped_findings.title: Phase N bundled with unrelated implementation and workflow artifacts
deduped_findings.description: Commit/branch range includes Safepay payment code, squad export behavior and tests, subscription methods, planning files, temporary Phase J artifacts, and .agents workflow outputs. Phase N notifications cannot be validated, deployed, or reverted independently.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Split production notification feature from unrelated phases, payment integration, planning, and workflow artifacts. Create focused Phase N commit containing only: schema migration, services, controllers, DTOs, frontend components, tests, and configuration. Remove .agents, payment, squad-export, and planning files from notification commit.

deduped_findings.title: Redis rate limit has no fallback if unreachable
deduped_findings.description: If Redis is unreachable during rate-limit check, SMS adapter catches exception and fails silently. No fallback strategy (skip rate limit or fail safe). Operational behavior should be documented.
deduped_findings.recommendation: Define fallback strategy: (A) skip rate limit and attempt send, (B) fail and mark PENDING for retry, or (C) hardcode deny to prevent cascade. Document chosen strategy in service comments and operations runbook.

Database Migrations: Add phoneNumber to UserProfile

2. Fix compilation (COMPILE_001): Resolve all TypeScript errors, add missing dependencies, validate both packages compile.
3. Fix schema drift (SCHEMA_001): Update modular Prisma sources, regenerate schema, verify migration + client consistency.
4. Verify event integration (INTEGRATION_001): Confirm AuctionsModule emits events and register @OnEvent listeners in NotificationService, or defer to Phase N.2 with clear documentation.
5. Implement durable delivery (DELIVERY_001): Add transactional outbox and background retry worker, or document retry behavior as deferred.
6. Align client/API contracts (FIND_001): Declare one versioning strategy and ensure frontend uses authenticated client.
7. Add tests (FIND_012): Write unit and E2E tests for core services, adapters, and frontend components.
8. Split commits (FIND_013): Isolate Phase N notifications from payment, planning, and other artifacts.
